notes.title: Try out the DEMO NOW!
notes.content:
It's one week until Halloween! 🎃

And as we promised, we delivered Andrew's Nightmare demo version. Face Andrew's deepest fears as you explore his darkest memories during his unsettling therapy sessions with Dr. Braun.

In this free demo, you'll get to play the first chapter of the game, where you'll explore Andy's house and witness the early stages of his DOWNFALL.

The full game is currently in development, and all reviews will be taken as constructive feedback for its improvement. So we would love to hear your thoughts after you've played it!


For more information about the developing process, please join our Discord server! https://discord.gg/Bnpydfggwd

notes.title: Real human voices have arrived in Andrew's Nightmare! 🎙️
notes.content:
Dear Community,

How have you been lately? Over the past few weeks, the team has been through a whirlwind of major changes and improvements that we’ll gradually be communicating. Now, we’re excited to announce that our development team has integrated human voices recorded exclusively for Andrew's Nightmare.

Meet the Voices Behind the Characters:

Valentín Ángel Fernández

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963977/300329ad101f8e15bc588b787f979d7e9eb1944b.jpg

With extensive experience in voice acting and performance, Valentín is a talented actor who knows how to convey deep emotions and bring complex characters to life. His ability to capture the essence of Andrew makes him the perfect choice for the role. We’re confident that his portrayal will elevate the protagonist’s story to new heights, fulfilling our aspirations from the early design stages of the game.

George Ledoux

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963977/4a8cd3e50e465ef799b26d296ee1bb2e6b97cc3b.jpg

He will be the voice of the enigmatic Dr. Braun. With an impressive catalog of work in the video game industry, George is widely recognized for his versatility and ability to bring a wide range of characters to life. His experience includes prominent roles in acclaimed titles where he has demonstrated his skill in creating unique and memorable characters. We couldn’t pass up the opportunity to have his talent bring our guide and professional, Dr. Braun, to life. We’re excited to see how his performance will add a new dimension to this intriguing character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963977/a6cc677eb0dd8822863add468100a678cecc67f1.jpg(Valentín’s recording studio, where several of Andrew’s voices for the game were recorded)

Things are getting more and more interesting, and the team is preparing to announce a very important news soon.

Join our Discord community to stay updated

notes.title: Join our Discord Community!
notes.content:
Join the Nightmare with us!
We are developing Andrew's Nightmare and we want you to be part of this unique experience. Join our Discord community and witness how a nightmare comes to life. This is your chance to be involved in every chilling detail from concept to release.

In our Discord server you will be able to:

 Receive exclusive news and updates: 
Be the first to know about development progress.

Ask questions, share your ideas, and get to know the team behind the game.
